passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
passages.sermon: This psalm is for the choirmaster.\r\nThe sons of Korah wrote this psalm.

passages.text: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
The sons of Korah wrote this psalm.
The psalm is for the choirmaster.
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD showed favor to His land.
The LORD restored Jacob.
Jacob was in captivity.
The LORD brought Jacob out of captivity.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שְׁבוּת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the subject of this psalm.
The LORD forgave the iniquity of His people.
The LORD covered all their sin.
The LORD withheld all His fury.
The LORD turned away from His burning anger.
Selah.
passages.original: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־ חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃ אָסַ֥פְתָּ כָל־ עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ הֱ֝שִׁיב֗וֹתָ מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
passages.sermon:
God saves us.
We call to God.
We ask God to restore us.
We ask God to turn away His anger from us.
passages.original: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
passages.sermon:
God is the God of Israel.
God sometimes becomes angry with His people.
The people ask God a question.
They ask, "Will You be angry with us forever?"
They also ask, "Will You keep Your anger for all generations?"
passages.original: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־ בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

passages.text: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
passages.sermon:
God, You have the power to restore life to us.
You can revive us again.
Your people depend on You.
Your people will rejoice in You when You revive them.
Your people find joy in You.
passages.original: הֲֽלֹא־ אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
passages.sermon: O LORD, You are loving and devoted.\r\nShow us Your loving devotion.\r\nGive us Your salvation.
passages.original: הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־ לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God speaks to His people.
God speaks to His saints.
God speaks peace to them.
I will listen to what God says.
God will not let His people return to foolishness.
passages.original: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־ יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־ עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־ חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־ יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃

passages.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God saves people.
God gives salvation to those who fear Him.
God is close to those who honor Him.
God brings His glory to our land.
God wants His glory to live among us.
passages.original: אַ֤ךְ׀ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
passages.sermon:
God shows loving devotion.
God shows faithfulness.
Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together.
God acts with righteousness.
God brings peace.
Righteousness and peace have come together closely.
passages.original: חֶֽסֶד־ וֶאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ׃

passages.text: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
passages.sermon: Faithfulness grows from the earth.\r\nRighteousness looks down from heaven.
passages.original: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃

passages.text: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
passages.sermon: The LORD gives what is good.\r\nOur land produces its harvest.
passages.original: גַּם־ יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
Righteousness goes before God.
Righteousness prepares the way for God’s steps.
Righteousness leads and makes the path ready for God.
passages.original: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
